bull.b: Braze producing positive operating and free cash flow while still reporting GAAP losses signals improving cash conversion and operational discipline. Durable FCF supports reinvestment in product, funds execution of Decisioning Studio scale, reduces financing dependency and gives flexibility over the next 2–6 months.

A subscription-heavy revenue base (93% subscription, ~99% recurring including services) creates predictable cash flows and high customer lifetime visibility. This structural mix supports durable retention, upsell economics and reliable RPO conversion, reducing short-term churn sensitivity and aiding longer-term planning.

A $1.1B RPO backlog growing ~30% YoY and accelerating current RPO provide multi-quarter revenue visibility and justify capacity investments. Coupled with rising large-account counts, this structural backlog underpins durable revenue conversion and supports predictable scaling of sales, delivery resources and product investment.

bear.b: Revenue growth has decelerated to ~6.6% TTM from prior high‑teens/50% ranges. Persistently slower top-line expansion threatens operating leverage, stretches the timeline to sustainable GAAP profitability, and increases reliance on upsells, enterprise deals and new product adoption to reaccelerate long-term growth.

bear.t: Ongoing GAAP Losses and Negative ROE
bear.b: Despite margin improvement, Braze remains GAAP-loss making with negative ROE, meaning equity is still being eroded. This structural profitability gap constrains capital allocation, heightens execution risk for scaling investments, and requires sustained margin expansion to convert cash flow gains into shareholder returns.

Rising premium messaging volumes, carrier fee pressure and earlier Decisioning Studio supply constraints have compressed gross margins and forced accelerated hiring. These are durable operational challenges: margin pressure from channel economics and execution risk from rapid scale can persist until pricing, product self‑service and delivery capacity normalize.
